name: native-composer
description: The chat input bar: a growing text field plus an explicit send control. Return inserts a newline, because a phone keyboard has no modifier to distinguish send from newline.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called with the trimmed value on Enter or form submit.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes on the form wrapper.

props.name: onChangeText
props.description: Called with the new draft on every edit. Replaces the web onValueChange.

props.name: busy
props.description: Block input and the send control while a reply streams

props.name: sendLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the send control

slots.name: children
slots.description: Trailing action buttons rendered after the textarea.

examples.title: Basic composer
examples.description: Draft held by the parent, sent on the button
examples.code:
<Composer
  value={draft}
  onChangeText={setDraft}
  onSubmit={(message) => {
    void send(message);
    setDraft("");
  }}
/>

examples.title: Blocked while streaming
examples.description: busy dims the field and shows a spinner in the send control

examples.title: Pinned above the keyboard
examples.description: The composer sits under the message list inside a keyboard-aware view
examples.code:
<KeyboardAvoidingView
  behavior={Platform.OS === "ios" ? "padding" : undefined}
  className="flex-1"
>
  <MessageList
    messages={messages}
    keyExtractor={(message) => message.id}
    renderMessage={(message) => (
      <Message role={message.role}><Text>{message.content}</Text></Message>
    )}
  />
  <Composer value={draft} onChangeText={setDraft} onSubmit={send} />
</KeyboardAvoidingView>

ai.whenToUse: Use as the input bar of a chat surface. Hold the draft in the parent, clear it after sending, and pass busy while a reply is streaming.
ai.whenNotToUse: Don't use it as a general form field (use Input or Textarea). Don't use it for a single-line search box. Don't put it inside a scrolling list; it belongs pinned below one.
commonMistakes: Expecting Return to send — it inserts a newline here, because a phone keyboard has no Shift-Return to distinguish the two; sending is the button's job
Forgetting to clear the draft after onSubmit, leaving the sent text in the field
Not passing busy while a reply streams, so the user can fire a second request into a half-finished turn
Placing it outside a KeyboardAvoidingView, so the keyboard covers the bar the moment it is focused
Sending an untrimmed value — the component hands onSubmit the trimmed text and refuses to send whitespace
ai.accessibilityNotes: The send control is a real button with an accessible name from sendLabel, and it reports disabled while the draft is empty or a reply is streaming — so a screen-reader user knows why nothing happens. The field is multi-line and grows to a bounded height, keeping long drafts readable without pushing the list off screen. Keyboard avoidance is the caller's job: wrap the screen in a KeyboardAvoidingView so the bar stays visible.
